boundary: upper quasi-Dirac mass cluster from R1698, with generated low-energy y_d and all other inputs transported on the same R1709 solution
return_sign_convention: sigma_s=+1, sigma_d=-1, sigma_b=+1 or -1 fixed through transport. The physical right-to-left identification and zero contact are independent hypotheses.
width_definition: Per-observable published marginal standard errors, quoted components for the three semileptonic moduli in quadrature, historical R1386 MZ MSbar Yukawa marginals. No combined likelihood.
